`mkdir`: make directories.

## Synopsis

<strong>mkdir</strong> \[<strong>-p</strong>\] <em>dir</em>...

## Description

<strong>mkdir</strong> makes each directory named. It is an error if one exists already, or if its parent does not.

## Options

<strong>-p</strong>
: Make missing parent directories too, and say nothing about directories that exist. It applies to the directories named after it.

## Exit status

0 if every directory was made; 1 if any could not be.

## Notes

<strong>-p</strong> is the only option; any other word, even one starting with <strong>-</strong>, is a directory name.

## See also

<strong>rmdir</strong>(1), <strong>rm</strong>(1), <strong>mktemp</strong>(1)
